{{Quote|He happened to notice his datapad was set for the Imperial oasis base.|[[Eyan McDermitt]] speaking of Jubai Laetlii|<ref name="SWG:CE" />}}
The '''Imperial Oasis''' was a small body of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], near the [[Mospic High Range/Legends|Mospic High Range]] and the [[Jawa mountain fortress/Legends|Jawa Mountain Fortress]]. It was considered one of Tatooine's greatest vistas by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Accompanied by a small [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]], the oasis and its base were occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was frequently patrolled by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darkstone]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], also oversaw a [[Mission to rescue Doctor Bledsoe|mission]] from the oasis to rescue [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bledsoe]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction of the first]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Description==
[[File:ImperialOasisBuildings.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A couple of buildings at the Imperial Oasis base]]
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Oasis was a small oasis on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], located west of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], and north of the [[Jawa mountain fortress/Legends|Jawa Mountain Fortress]]. It consisted of a small body of [[Water/Legends|water]] surrounded by [[Palm tree/Legends|palm trees]] and other [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]]. Though the water was mostly shallow, parts of it were deep enough to swim in. The water was home to a number of [[Species/Legends|lifeforms]], including various [[Fish/Legends|fish]] varieties. Indeed, [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] at the oasis was possible for anyone who desired to do so. As a whole, the Imperial Oasis was nestled within a large valley. Surrounding the oasis were tall [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], many of which joined the [[Mospic High Range/Legends|Mospic High Range]].<ref name="SWG" />

The Imperial Oasis was accompanied by a small [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[Garrison/Legends|base]]. The base was known to have been fully built following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The outpost was frequently patrolled by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Despite being a military installation, the Imperial Oasis base included structures that mirrored typical [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] [[Architect/Legends|architecture]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, two of its structures were decorated with furniture, consisting of several [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedrooms]], and were occupied by civilians. Outdoors, the Imperial Oasis base had a café-like area consisting of [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] tables with parasols. However, military aspects were still plentiful. The garrison consisted of three watch towers and a small metallic outpost building. The appearance of these structures contrasted greatly with the more civilian-like, [[Color/Legends|tan]]-colored buildings. The Imperial Oasis base also had a portion of its perimeter protected by a solid metal barrier.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|One of the few Oases on Tatooine, Imperials settled near this one to ensure they had a plentiful supply of water|Description of the Imperial Oasis|<ref name="SWG:PVT" />}}
[[File:ImperialOasisIncident.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The painting ''[[Imperial Oasis Incident]]'']]
The Empire built an outpost near the oasis to have access to a plentiful supply of water.<ref name="SWG:PVT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine}}</ref> Because Tatooine only had around one percent of surface water, the location was a uniquely rare sight.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> During the time of the Galactic Civil War, stormtroopers would frequently patrol the garrison. An [[Imperial recruiter]] was also stationed by the garrison's parked [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]]. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] named [[Darkstone]] was stationed at the Imperial Oasis base. By that time, his service as the main point of contact in regard to Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who found themselves in hostage situations was drawing to an end.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
From there, Darkstone tasked Imperials with a [[Mission to rescue Doctor Bledsoe|mission to rescue]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bledsoe]] from a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]].<ref name="SWG" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] named [[Jubai Laetlii]] also stayed at the oasis during that time. He illegally possessed plans for a new prototype military [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] that was in development by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. A [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who worked for a Human male named [[Sarlis Beni]] stole the encrypted [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] from Jubai in order to protect Incom's intellectual property.<ref name="SWG:CE" /> Around this time, a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] visited the Imperial Oasis, and considered it one of Tatooine's greatest vistas.<ref name="SWG:PVT" />
{{Endgame}}
Later, an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] painted a depiction of an explosion occurring at the Imperial Oasis. This painting was titled ''[[Imperial Oasis Incident]]'', and was produced by a Human female named [[Navari Trik]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] as part of the [[Galactic Empire Painting Contest]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies Official Website">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67761&month=052008|text=Friday Feature – Calling on All Artists}}</ref><ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This area is cool because it's an Imperial facility right next to a small lake. It has patio tables and chairs and has two cantina-type structures (fully decorated). It comes across as an officer's club of sorts. It would be good for RP events, Imperial meetings or as a PVP location. As a bonus it has a Lambda shuttle parked on a landing pad to give it an "official" look.|[[Jason Ryan|Jason "Pex" Ryan]]|<ref name="Pex">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Events&message.id=9420|text=Locations for Player Events - What are your favorites?}}</ref>}}
The [[W:c:swg:Imperial Oasis|Imperial Oasis]] was one of four bodies of water on the [[W:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[W:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The other three were the [[Oasis South|Southern Oasis]], the [[Oasis Northeast|Northeastern Oasis]], and the [[Oasis East|Eastern Oasis]].<ref name="SWG" /> In the game, [[W:c:swg:Player character|players]] could visit the Imperial Oasis to complete the [[W:c:swg:Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine|Panoramic Vistas]] [[W:c:swg:Collection|collection]] for Tatooine. Completion of this collection awarded players with a [[W:c:swg:A Panoramic Painting - Tatooine|painting]] of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="SWG:PVT" /> At the oasis, players could also find a [[W:c:swg:Bubbling Rock Collection|bubbling rock]], and the right bracer of [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Both items helped to complete [[W:c:swg:Bubbling Rock Collection|two other]] [[W:c:swg:Lost Imperial Shock Trooper Armor Collection|separate]] collections.<ref name="SWG:LISTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Imperial Shock Trooper Armor}}</ref><ref name="SWG:BR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Bubbling Rock}}</ref>

In the game, a [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] titled "[[W:c:swg:Corporate Espionage|Corporate Espionage]]" required that the player go to the Imperial Oasis to obtain an encrypted datapad from [[W:c:swg:Jubai Laetlii|Jubai Laetlii]]. If the player was a [[W:c:swg:Spy|spy]], they could either steal the datapad harmlessly, or kill Jubai altogether. The [[W:c:swg:Quest Journal|quest journal]] mentioned that Jubai was a capable fighter, and that killing him might prove difficult. It suggested that simply stealing the datapad might be the player's best option. Even though the quest was tailored for players of the spy [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]], players of other professions could carry out the mission as well. Because stealing was an ability reserved only for the spy profession, players of other professions were required to kill Jubai to receive the datapad and complete the quest.<ref name="SWG:CE" /> In the game, players of the [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Imperial faction]] could perform a mission for [[W:c:swg:Colonel Darkstone|Colonel Darkstone]] at the Imperial Oasis. The [[W:c:swg:Guide to the Corellian Corvette|mission]] required players to go to a [[W:c:swg:Rebel Alliance|Rebel]] Corvette to rescue Dr. Bledsoe. Although players could choose not to do any of the quests or collections connected to the Imperial Oasis, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />

In celebration of the sixth anniversary of ''Star Wars Galaxies'', Sony Online Entertainment announced a "Galactic Call to Arms Fan Art" Contest. From Monday, [[May 18]], [[2009]] to Monday, [[June 8]], 2009, players could submit their own artwork for the chance for it to be nominated, voted on, and included in the game as a [[W:c:swg:Decorative art|decorative]] [[W:c:swg:Housing|house]] [[W:c:swg:Posters|painting]].<ref name="SOE Contest">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66971|text=''Star Wars Galaxies''™ "Galactic Call to Arms Fan Art" Contest}}</ref> At the Galactic Gathering at the 2009 Fan Faire, Sony Online Entertainment announced the three finalists for each of the categories. From the Imperial category, the three finalists included a painting titled ''Tightening the Noose'' by Darev Sool of [[W:c:swg:TCPrime|TCPrime]], ''Scouting the Forest for the Main Force'' by Gardas of [[W:c:swg:Chilastra|Chilastra]], and [[W:c:swg:Imperial Oasis Incident|''Imperial Oasis Incident'']] by [[Lexx Yovel]] of [[W:c:swg:Starsider|Starsider]]. Players could then vote on these three paintings on the ''Star Wars Galaxies'' official message boards from Wednesday, [[July 22]], 2009 to Wednesday, [[August 5]], 2009.<ref name="SonyCite-Galactic Call to Arms Fan Art Contest! – Time to vote">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68379&month=072009|text="Galactic Call to Arms Fan Art" Contest! &ndash; Time to vote}}</ref><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=963162|text="Galactic Call to Arms Fan Art" Contest! -- VOTE HERE! (Imperial finalists)}}</ref> At the end of the vote, ''Imperial Oasis Incident'' emerged victorious,<ref name="SOE Contest Winners">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68416&month=082009|text="Galactic Call to Arms Fan Art" Contest! &ndash; The Winner is!}}</ref> and was added to the game on [[October 12]], 2009 as part of [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref> where players could freely obtain the painting from Navari Trik in [[W:c:swg:Mos Eisley|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:G14">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Game Update 14}}</ref>

[[Jason Ryan|Jason "Pex" Ryan]], the former events manager of ''Star Wars Galaxies'', also mentioned that the Imperial Oasis was one of his favorite in-game locations.<ref name="Pex" />
